Lipoma

Lipoma (peak incidence 40–60 years) vs. pilomatrixoma (typically <30 years, often childhood/adolescence) or dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans (younger adults but often progressive, fixed, infiltrative)

gaps.discriminates: Pilomatrixoma (characteristic calcification, rock-hard consistency) vs. lipoma (no calcification, typically soft-to-firm but not stony)
